actions.create_artifact.description: Turn Markdown or HTML into a branded PDF and/or PNG with your logo, colour, header and footer, and get hosted links. Rendex offers no wait option here, so this call can fail with HTTP 408 TIMEOUT on the vendor side; if it does, use Render Screenshot with Format PDF and Wait Until Load event instead.
actions.create_artifact.props.accent_col: Brand colour as a hex code, like #4f46e5.
actions.create_artifact.props.content.de: The Markdown or HTML to turn into a document (up to 4 MB).
actions.create_artifact.props.expires_in: How long the links stay valid, 3600 (1 hour) to 2592000 (30 days). Default 1 day.
actions.create_artifact.props.footer.des: Text shown at the bottom of the document.
actions.create_artifact.props.formats.de: Which files to create. Default both PDF and PNG; each format costs one credit.
actions.create_artifact.props.header.des: Text shown at the top of the document.
actions.create_artifact.props.input_form: Whether Content is Markdown or HTML. Default Markdown.
actions.create_artifact.props.logo_url.d: Public URL of a logo image to place on the document.
Paper size of the PDF. Default A4.
actions.create_artifact.props.template_d: Values for Rendex {{placeholders}} in Content, like {"customer": "Ada"} (up to 256 KB). Activepieces replaces {{...}} that you type in a field with its own data before Rendex sees it, so placeholders typed here never reach Rendex. Template Data only works when the HTML or Markdown with {{placeholders}} is mapped in from an earlier step (mapped values are passed as-is); otherwise insert the values directly with the data selector.
actions.create_render_link.description: Create a signed, cached image URL that renders a URL, HTML or Markdown when it is opened, for emails, og:image tags or embeds.
actions.create_render_link.props.block_c: Yes hides common cookie and consent banners. Default no.
Device preset (viewport, scale and user agent). Default desktop.
actions.create_render_link.props.expires: How long the link stays valid, 3600 (1 hour) to 2592000 (30 days). Default 30 days.
actions.create_render_link.props.full_pa: Yes captures the whole scrollable page (cut at 16,384 px) instead of the viewport. Default no.
Viewport height in pixels, 240 to 2160. Default 800.
actions.create_render_link.props.hide_se: CSS selectors of elements to hide first, like .chat-widget (up to 50).
actions.create_render_link.props.html.de: HTML markup to render (up to 5 MB). Give exactly one of URL, HTML or Markdown.
actions.create_render_link.props.markdow: Markdown to render (up to 5 MB). Give exactly one of URL, HTML or Markdown.
actions.create_render_link.props.selecto: CSS selector of one element to capture instead of the page, like #pricing.
actions.create_render_link.props.templat: Values for Rendex {{placeholders}} in the HTML or Markdown, like {"name": "Ada"} (up to 256 KB). Not allowed with URL. Activepieces replaces {{...}} that you type in a field with its own data before Rendex sees it, so placeholders typed here never reach Rendex. Template Data only works when the HTML or Markdown with {{placeholders}} is mapped in from an earlier step (mapped values are passed as-is); otherwise insert the values directly with the data selector.
actions.create_render_link.props.timeout: How long Rendex waits for the page to load, 5 to 60. Default 30.
actions.create_render_link.props.url.des: A public web page to capture, like https://example.com. Give exactly one of URL, HTML or Markdown.
actions.create_render_link.props.wait_un: When the page counts as loaded. Default Load event for HTML and Markdown (network idle times out on inline content) and Network idle (2 connections) for a URL.
actions.create_render_link.props.width.d: Viewport width in pixels, 320 to 3840. Default 1280.
actions.create_watch.description: Start monitoring a web page for visual or text changes on a schedule.
actions.create_watch.props.ai_summary.de: Yes adds a one-sentence summary of what changed to each run (Pro plan and up). Default no.
actions.create_watch.props.delay_ms.desc: Extra wait after load, 0 to 10000 ms.
actions.create_watch.props.device.descri: Device preset for each check. Default desktop.
actions.create_watch.props.diff_mode.des: What counts as a change. Default Visual and text.
actions.create_watch.props.full_page.des: Yes watches the whole scrollable page, no only the viewport. Default yes for watches.
actions.create_watch.props.hide_selector: CSS selectors to hide before each check, like .ad-slot (up to 50).
actions.create_watch.props.ignore_text.d: Text or /regex/ removed before the text comparison, like timestamps or counters (up to 50).
actions.create_watch.props.interval_minu: How often to check, 5 to 43200 minutes. Default 1440 (daily). Your plan sets the minimum: Free 1440, Basic 180, Starter 60, Pro 30.
actions.create_watch.props.name.descript: A label for the watch (up to 120 characters).
Where change alerts go. Must be your Rendex account email. Leave empty for no email alerts (the watch is created with no alert email; check results with List Watch Runs or the Watch Detected a Change trigger).
actions.create_watch.props.paused.descri: Yes creates the watch paused: no baseline capture and no credit until you resume it. Default no.
actions.create_watch.props.selector.desc: CSS selector of one element to watch instead of the whole page, like #price.
actions.create_watch.props.threshold.des: Visual sensitivity, 0 to 1. Default 0.01 alerts on any visual change; 0.06 or more alerts only on major changes.
actions.create_watch.props.url.descripti: The public page to monitor, like https://example.com/pricing.
actions.create_watch.props.wait_until.de: When the page counts as loaded.
actions.create_watch.props.webhook_url.d: HTTPS URL that receives a signed request on each change (Starter plan and up).
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_watch.description: Permanently delete a website change watch and its check history.
actions.delete_watch.props.watch_id.desc: The watch to use. You can also map a Watch ID from List Watches or Create Watch.
actions.extract_content.description: Load a web page in a real browser and return its main content as Markdown, JSON or HTML, with title and excerpt.
actions.extract_content.props.block_cook: Yes hides common cookie and consent banners. Default no.
actions.extract_content.props.device.des: Device preset (viewport, scale and user agent). Default desktop.
actions.extract_content.props.extract_fo: Format of the returned content. Default Markdown.
actions.extract_content.props.hide_selec: CSS selectors of elements to hide first, like .chat-widget (up to 50).
actions.extract_content.props.timeout_se: How long Rendex waits for the page to load, 5 to 60. Default 30.
actions.extract_content.props.url.descri: The public web page to read, like https://example.com/blog/post.
actions.extract_content.props.wait_until: When the page counts as loaded. Default Load event for HTML and Markdown (network idle times out on inline content) and Network idle (2 connections) for a URL.
actions.get_account.description: Get your Rendex plan, credits used and remaining this month, and your per-minute rate limit.
actions.get_watch.description: Get one website change watch with its settings, status and last check.
actions.get_watch.props.watch_id.descrip: The watch to use. You can also map a Watch ID from List Watches or Create Watch.
actions.list_watch_runs.description: List the checks of a website change watch, newest first, with what changed.
actions.list_watch_runs.props.cursor.des: The Next Cursor from a previous List Watch Runs run, to get older runs.
actions.list_watch_runs.props.watch_id.d: The watch to use. You can also map a Watch ID from List Watches or Create Watch.
actions.list_watches.description: List your website change watches, one page at a time.
actions.list_watches.props.cursor.descri: The Next Cursor from a previous List Watches run, to get the next page.
actions.list_watches.props.status.descri: Only watches in this state. Default all.
actions.render_screenshot.description: Render a URL, HTML or Markdown to a PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF file, with viewport, element, wait and extraction options.
actions.render_screenshot.props.block_ad: Block ads and trackers. Default yes.
actions.render_screenshot.props.block_co: Yes hides common cookie and consent banners. Default no.
actions.render_screenshot.props.dark_mod: Yes renders with prefers-color-scheme: dark. Default no.
actions.render_screenshot.props.delay_ms: Extra wait after load, 0 to 10000 ms. Default 0.
actions.render_screenshot.props.device.d: Device preset (viewport, scale and user agent). Default desktop.
actions.render_screenshot.props.extract_: Format of the extracted content when Extract Text is yes. Default Markdown.
Yes also returns the page content as text. Default no.
actions.render_screenshot.props.full_pag: Yes captures the whole scrollable page (cut at 16,384 px) instead of the viewport. Default no.
actions.render_screenshot.props.height.d: Viewport height in pixels, 240 to 2160. Default 800.
actions.render_screenshot.props.hide_sel: CSS selectors of elements to hide first, like .chat-widget (up to 50).
actions.render_screenshot.props.html.des: HTML markup to render (up to 5 MB). Give exactly one of URL, HTML or Markdown.
actions.render_screenshot.props.markdown: Markdown to render (up to 5 MB). Give exactly one of URL, HTML or Markdown.
actions.render_screenshot.props.pdf_form: Paper size when Format is PDF. Default A4.
actions.render_screenshot.props.pdf_land: Yes prints the PDF in landscape. Default no.
JPEG or WebP quality, 1 to 100. Default 80.
actions.render_screenshot.props.selector: CSS selector of one element to capture instead of the page, like #pricing.
actions.render_screenshot.props.template: Values for Rendex {{placeholders}} in the HTML or Markdown, like {"name": "Ada"} (up to 256 KB). Not allowed with URL. Activepieces replaces {{...}} that you type in a field with its own data before Rendex sees it, so placeholders typed here never reach Rendex. Template Data only works when the HTML or Markdown with {{placeholders}} is mapped in from an earlier step (mapped values are passed as-is); otherwise insert the values directly with the data selector.
actions.render_screenshot.props.timeout_: How long Rendex waits for the page to load, 5 to 60. Default 30.
actions.render_screenshot.props.url.desc: A public web page to capture, like https://example.com. Give exactly one of URL, HTML or Markdown.
actions.render_screenshot.props.wait_for: CSS selector to wait for before capturing, like #chart.
actions.render_screenshot.props.wait_unt: When the page counts as loaded. Default Load event for HTML and Markdown (network idle times out on inline content) and Network idle (2 connections) for a URL.
actions.render_screenshot.props.width.de: Viewport width in pixels, 320 to 3840. Default 1280.
actions.render_to_image.description: Render raw HTML, a URL, or Markdown to an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP) or a PDF.
actions.render_to_image.props.content.de: The content to render, based on the Source you selected.
Capture the full scrollable page instead of just the viewport.
actions.render_to_image.props.source_typ: Render from raw HTML, a live URL, or Markdown.
actions.run_watch_now.description: Queue an immediate check of a website change watch, outside its schedule.
actions.run_watch_now.props.watch_id.des: The watch to use. You can also map a Watch ID from List Watches or Create Watch.
actions.test_watch.description: Dry-run watch settings on a page to see whether it can be captured, without creating a watch.
actions.test_watch.props.delay_ms.descri: Extra wait after load, 0 to 10000 ms.
actions.test_watch.props.device.descript: Device preset for each check. Default desktop.
actions.test_watch.props.diff_mode.descr: What counts as a change. Default Visual and text.
actions.test_watch.props.full_page.descr: Yes watches the whole scrollable page, no only the viewport. Default yes for watches.
CSS selectors to hide before each check, like .ad-slot (up to 50).
actions.test_watch.props.ignore_text.des: Text or /regex/ removed before the text comparison, like timestamps or counters (up to 50).
actions.test_watch.props.selector.descri: CSS selector of one element to watch instead of the whole page, like #price.
actions.test_watch.props.threshold.descr: Visual sensitivity, 0 to 1. Default 0.01 alerts on any visual change; 0.06 or more alerts only on major changes.
actions.test_watch.props.url.description: The public page to test, like https://example.com/pricing.
actions.test_watch.props.wait_until.desc: When the page counts as loaded.
actions.update_watch.description: Change, pause or resume a website change watch. Fields you leave empty stay as they are.
actions.update_watch.props.ai_summary.de: Turn the one-sentence change summary on or off (Pro plan and up).
actions.update_watch.props.clear_hide_se: Yes stops hiding elements before each check.
actions.update_watch.props.clear_ignore_: Yes stops removing text before the text comparison.
actions.update_watch.props.clear_selecto: Yes watches the whole page again instead of one element.
actions.update_watch.props.delay_ms.desc: Extra wait after load, 0 to 10000 ms.
actions.update_watch.props.device.descri: Device preset for each check. Default desktop.
actions.update_watch.props.diff_mode.des: What counts as a change. Default Visual and text.
actions.update_watch.props.full_page.des: Yes watches the whole scrollable page, no only the viewport. Default yes for watches.
actions.update_watch.props.hide_selector: CSS selectors to hide before each check, like .ad-slot (up to 50).
actions.update_watch.props.ignore_text.d: Text or /regex/ removed before the text comparison, like timestamps or counters (up to 50).
actions.update_watch.props.interval_minu: New check frequency, 5 to 43200 minutes (your plan sets the minimum).
New alert email. Must be your Rendex account email.
actions.update_watch.props.paused.descri: Pause or resume the watch. Default keep as is.
actions.update_watch.props.selector.desc: CSS selector of one element to watch instead of the whole page, like #price.
actions.update_watch.props.threshold.des: Visual sensitivity, 0 to 1. Default 0.01 alerts on any visual change; 0.06 or more alerts only on major changes.
actions.update_watch.props.url.descripti: A new page to monitor. Changing it resets the baseline.
actions.update_watch.props.wait_until.de: When the page counts as loaded.
actions.update_watch.props.watch_id.desc: The watch to use. You can also map a Watch ID from List Watches or Create Watch.
actions.update_watch.props.webhook_url.d: New HTTPS webhook target (Starter plan and up).
auth.description: Your Rendex API key (it starts with rdx_). Sign in at rendex.dev, open the dashboard and copy a key under API Keys. The free plan includes 100 renders per month.
description: Render HTML, a URL or Markdown to an image or PDF, extract page content, create render links and branded documents, and watch web pages for changes.
triggers.new_watch_change.description: Triggers when a Rendex watch finishes a check that found a change (or, optionally, any finished or failed check).
Which checks start the flow. Default The page changed.
triggers.new_watch_change.props.watch_id: The watch to use. You can also map a Watch ID from List Watches or Create Watch.
